Expired historical Valid-Until is disabled only on these fixed snapshot entries. Every deb is hashed before installation.

known_source_issue.scope: The locked package set excludes winbind and libpam-winbind. This probe uses standalone local passdb with no PAM account provisioning or domain authentication. This is a component-exclusion observation, not a vulnerability-free image claim.

limitations: The immutable snapshot does not receive future security fixes; refresh and re-review before a later batch.
No complete vulnerability attestation of all base image or dependency binaries is claimed.
Container runtime behavior, non-root Samba startup and NTLM flow remain unverified until the isolated remote probe.
Build image includes generated disposable credentials and must not be published or exported to a shared cache.
